This is PLiZ's original rejected Scenario A export, retained as a regression
fixture. It is **not suitable for submission**. On 19 September 2026 the
organiser's portal reported 49 closure violations for these exact CSVs.
`reported_closures.json` records the week, activity, reported possession members
and locations copied by the user. The portal truncates member lists to three
and location lists to four. No personal or credential data is included.

The test requires an exact match for all 49 reports and a separate zero-closure
result for the organiser's own sample, without contacting the scoring portal.
